limitations: March2025 is new to this project, not prospective performance
March2025 has not previously been inspected in this project; registration precedes acquisition
Fixed surviving liquid asset universe; no historical L2 or queue
Worst-case stop before target when both barriers cross in a bar
No retuning or winner promotion after viewing the untouched test
Full lifecycle uses production pricing, structural plans, stop priority, causal position exits, partials and trailing. Database concurrency is tested separately.
Finite liquidity uses 1% of prior completed candle volume; future depth and order queue are unavailable.
Train/validation/test always reset separate EUR500 research capital; primary cash is never used.
BUY_AND_HOLD buys EUR75 per asset, leaving cash idle; it is not a fully invested index.
Historical proxy findings do not establish prospective profitability.
